commitments.target: customer support chats and call transcripts
commitments.detail: Data will be deleted after 30 days of processing.
Data will be processed in the US region only.
Vendor must maintain cyber liability insurance coverage of at least $500,000.
Company will be added as an additional insured party under the vendor's insurance policy.
Vendor agrees to allow annual audits by the company.
Indemnity cap for confidentiality and data breaches is unlimited.
